what: The wall-clock limits of this task's evaluation operations (README, Resource limits). Evaluation and the supplied scripts apply these values; an operation that exceeds its limit fails.
hardware: the task's four NVIDIA B200 GPUs at the registered recipe (tests/test_inkling_small_nvfp4.py, both classes)

startup.clock: process spawn through the first ready health response, including model load, startup compilation and graph capture; each launch of either class

install.applies: the documented editable install (README, Building), offline

http_request.applies: one HTTP request, or one explicitly submitted concurrent batch, with every input below long_input_tokens
http_request.clock: client dispatch through the complete response(s), including queueing and first-use compilation

http_request_long.applies: the same, with any input of at least long_input_tokens
http_request_long.clock: client dispatch through the complete response(s), including queueing and first-use compilation

registered_gsm8k.applies: one run of the registered GSM8K evaluation (10 shots, 200 questions, 512 new tokens, parallel 128)
registered_gsm8k.clock: first request through the last response

deterministic_helper.applies: one helper of the registered deterministic class

invocation.applies: one component correctness or timing invocation of the relative-attention entry point
invocation.clock: dispatch through the record, including JIT compilation, warm-up and allocation

unit_test_file.clock: collection and all selected cases of that file, including compilation

action.applies: a configuration, registry, identity or profile action, for example a cache flush, a server-information read or a profiler start or stop

teardown.applies: stopping a server or worker group
teardown.clock: TERM, then KILL after 10 s if needed, including reaping
